goal: Prevent wallet database write and erase failures from failing silently
Avoid divergence between in-memory wallet state and disk records that could cause corruption or data loss
agreement: Concept support for enforcing DB error handling and disk consistency (rkrux)
Objections on write failure edge cases and false corruption reports answered by author (jeanpablojp)

why: P2 because silent database write failures can cause in-memory state to desynchronize from disk records
Protects wallet users from unnoticed state divergence, data loss, and corrupted wallet files
